lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible across the mid-lateral flank; spot size decreases and density increases anteriorly toward the gill slits, forming a dense cluster of local maxima in the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of subtly higher pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating a fragmented grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and deep shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density arrangement of approximately 10-12 discrete, high-luminance circular spots is visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch or indentation is visible on the trailing (posterior) edge of the left pectoral fin. Two thin, linear, high-contrast features (likely attached organisms) are visible: one on the distal surface of the pectoral fin and one on the upper-mid flank.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region displays a high-frequency pattern of significantly smaller punctate spots compared to the larger, more widely spaced blobs on the posterior trunk.
